authority: Devon County Council / Devon & Dartmoor Historic Environment Record
source_family: Devon HER Listed buildings ArcGIS service layer 669
official_description: When buildings are listed they are placed on the statutory list; structures that might not be first thought of as buildings can be listed. Dataset maintained and amended by the Historic Environment Record at Devon County Council, based on data supplied by Historic England. Covers Devon, Torbay and Dartmoor HER administrative areas. Any records in central Exeter are out of date.
type_use_gap: The published schema has no explicit per-feature actual use/type field. Name is retained as source evidence only and is not converted into a use classification.
